metadata.title: How to Make Chipotle Chicken Tacos | Tacos
metadata.description:

Watch more How to Make Tacos videos: http://www.howcast.com/videos/514721-How-to-Make-Chipotle-Chicken-Tacos-Tacos

INGREDIENTS: 1-2 lb. boneless skinless chicken thighs; 8 bay leaves; 10 c. water; 5 T Better Than Bouillon chicken or veg stock; 8 dried chipotles, toasted, soaked, seeded; 3 T chipotles en adobo sauce. RECIPE: Mix stock in pot; add chicken, chiles, bay leaves. Cover and braise over med heat for 1.5 hours. Remove chicken from pot and shred or chop. Warm tortillas on dry pan and serve chicken in tortillas with toppings of your choosing, such as cilantro, chopped white onions or salsa.

Today I'm going to show you how to make chicken tacos, but not just any chicken tacos. I'm going to tell you how to make chipotle chicken tacos. And the reason why I put chipotles in it is because I don't like boring, unseasoned, unflavored chicken. This is going to be the best chicken taco you've ever had. So first I have boneless chicken thighs, nice dark meat, a little bit of fat in it. I have chipotles in adobo sauce, which you can find at your supermarket. That's going to add a nice, smoky flavor, a lot of depth to the stock. Bay leaves, again a nice little aromatic that's going to cook in there. So I right now have a vegetable stock going right now, nice, deep flavor, almost like a soup, because you really want this chicken to absorb a lot of flavor. So I'm going to put the chicken in here. 

We're looking at about two and half hours, maybe a little less to cook. You basically just want it to pull apart, almost like a shredded chicken. So then I'm going to add the chipotles, the aromatics. There we go. And here you have your stock now with your chicken, your chipotles in adobo, and your bay leaves, and you can just let that simmer for about two hours. And you will be so happy when that's over. It is going to be the best taco you've ever had. All right, guys. Get really excited, because this is the moment we've all been waiting for. The chicken is falling off the bone, full of flavor. I have fresh tortillas here. I have our tomato salsa we made. I have table sauce, which is to add a little bit of spice to it, limes, and cotija cheese. So I have a nice pan, hot. We're going to use two tortillas, because the meat is very full of juice, and it will break through one. So we always reinforce it with a second. 

All right. So that's cooking here, high heat. You want to get a little color if you can. In the chicken pot, I'm going to pull this up, and you can see I have this beautiful, shredded chicken falling off the bone. The chipotles are in here. They're falling apart. It's just going to be amazing when it all mixes together. So I'm going to focus on this tortilla right here. Don't burn yourself. We have beautiful brown color here. It takes about 30 seconds a side, at most. So that's pretty much done. I'm going to get my plate, because we're getting ready for game time here. All right. Flip. 

All right. There you go. So you see you have beautiful color here. It's awesome. All right. Take the chicken. Strain the juice a little bit. Chop it up. Oh my God. It looks amazing. You can still see the seeds from the chipotle, which is going to give it a nice kick. Beautiful. Awesome. All right. There we go. Look at the beautiful shredded chicken, guys. Put a little chunky salsa on here. Awesome. Sprinkle some of the cotija cheese, which is similar to a Parmesan. It's a salty cow's milk cheese. A little bit of lime. Awesome. And then if you want to take it up a notch, put a little bit of hot sauce. Perfect. There you go. Now the moment we've all been waiting for. Chipotle chicken taco. 

Awesome. See that juice? That's why we have the second tortilla. Who wants dry chicken, though? Oh my God. Banging. That's how you make a chipotle chicken taco.

nodes.plm_caption:
In a bright kitchen, a man in a black t-shirt demonstrates how to cook chipotle chicken tacos. The lighting is very bright. The background is white tiles. There are many pots and pans visible, as well as other cutlery and ingredients.
The man talks while standing in front of a cutting board, then moves to stand behind a stove, where he puts a plate with chicken on a burner and begins to prepare it. He uses tongs, and then puts it on a pan. He adds tortillas one by one, then puts it on a plate, plates the salsa, and puts a lime on the plate. Then he squeezes the lime and adds salt, and begins eating the tacos.
There are several bowls of ingredients visible.

summary.brief: A man cooks chipotle‑flavored chicken, browns two tortillas, assembles tacos with salsa, cheese, lime and hot sauce, and shows the finished dish with an ingredient list.
summary.detailed: The video opens with title graphics and a brief music cue. A man in a black t‑shirt introduces the recipe while raw chicken thighs, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, bay leaves and broth are displayed on a cutting board. He places the chicken and seasonings in a pot, covers it and lets it simmer until the meat is falling off the bone and looks shredded. He lifts the pot lid, pours the contents onto a plate, strains off excess liquid and shreds the chicken. In a hot skillet he browns two corn tortillas, flipping them to develop a light brown color, explaining that a second tortilla prevents the juicy filling from breaking through. He returns the shredded chicken to the skillet, then transfers it to the warmed tortillas. He tops each taco with chunky tomato salsa, crumbled cotija cheese, a squeeze of lime, a pinch of salt and chili powder, and a dash of hot sauce. He plates the assembled tacos, takes a bite, and the camera shows a close‑up of the finished taco. The segment ends with on‑screen graphics listing all the recipe ingredients and a Howcast branding logo.

action.detailed: Cook the chicken with chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, bay leaves and broth, shred it, brown two tortillas in a skillet, then layer the shredded chicken, salsa, cotija cheese, lime juice, salt, chili powder and hot sauce on the tortillas and serve the assembled tacos on a plate.
action.actor: a man wearing a black t‑shirt

This video features a man demonstrating how to cook a chicken taco with sauce.
The man is seen in a modern kitchen with a wooden counter top and steel appliances.  He demonstrates how to cook chicken in a pan while adding various ingredients to the pan, and then placing it in a metal pot to cook for a certain amount of time. He removes the cooked chicken from the metal pot with tongs, and places it in a hot pan to finish cooking it before putting it on tortillas, and topping it with sauce, tomatoes, onions, lime, salt, and pepper.

summary.brief: A man cooks chipotle‑spiced shredded chicken, heats two tortillas, and assembles them with salsa, cotija cheese, lime and hot sauce to make chipotle chicken tacos.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a Howcast title screen and a close‑up of a plated taco on a wooden board. The host – a man in a black t‑shirt with a watch – stands at a kitchen counter and introduces the chipotle chicken taco recipe. He shows raw boneless chicken thighs, dried chipotle peppers, bay leaves and a seasoned broth, adds them to a pot and lets the mixture simmer until the meat is tender and pulls apart. He removes the pot, strains a little of the cooking liquid, and shreds (or chops) the chicken. He then heats a dry skillet, places two corn tortillas in it and browns each side for about 30 seconds, flipping them once. The tortillas are set aside on a plate. He tops a tortilla with the shredded chicken, adds a spoonful of chunky tomato salsa, sprinkles crumbled cotija cheese, squeezes fresh lime juice, and drizzles hot sauce. Because the filling is very juicy, he places a second tortilla on top and folds the taco. The finished chipotle chicken tacos are displayed on a plate, ready to eat.

action.detailed: Heat a skillet, brown two corn tortillas on each side, place shredded chipotle‑flavored chicken on a tortilla, add salsa, cotija cheese, lime juice and hot sauce, then fold a second tortilla over the fillings and serve.
action.actor: The host, a man wearing a black t‑shirt and a watch, standing at the kitchen counter

summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Full Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLALQuK1NDrhp_py0Oe5sB1GuAwKrI7wn
-
-
Like these Taco Recipes !!! Check out the official app http://apple.co/1kIbG9L

Watch more How to Make Tacos videos: http://www.howcast.com/videos/514721-How-to-Make-Chipotle-Chicken-Tacos-Tacos

INGREDIENTS: 1-2 lb. boneless skinless chicken thighs; 8 bay leaves; 10 c. water; 5 T Better Than Bouillon chicken or veg stock; 8 dried chipotles, toasted, soaked, seeded; 3 T chipotles en adobo sauce. RECIPE: Mix stock in pot; add chicken, chiles, bay leaves. Cover and braise over med heat for 1.5 hours. Remo
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with title graphics and a brief music cue. A man in a black t‑shirt introduces the recipe while raw chicken thighs, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, bay leaves and broth are displayed on a cutting board. He places the chicken and seasonings in a pot, covers it and lets it simmer until the meat is falling off the bone and looks shredded. He lifts the pot lid, pours the contents onto a plate, strains off excess liquid and shreds the chicken. In a hot skillet he browns two corn tortillas, flipping them to develop a light brown color, explaining that a second tortilla prevents the juicy filling from breaking through. He returns the shredded chicken to the skillet, then transfers it to the warmed tortillas. He tops each taco with chunky tomato salsa, crumbled cotija cheese, a squeeze of lime, a pinch of salt and chili powder, and a dash of hot sauce. He plates the assembled tacos, takes a bite, and the camera shows a close‑up of the finished taco. The segment ends with on‑screen graphics listing all the recipe ingredients and a Howcast branding logo.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
